text.tspan: Distributed tree of ControlBoards: events ripple DOWN, data / attempt / finish / post-select ripple UP
RootOutputSync → detector stream with global indices & round markers
+ Postselect → ps_out fast path to root
Physical layer: control cores / AWGs → qubits → readout
(in simulation: one StimReadout per leaf replays recorded measurements — see 11_stim_readout_loop)
Monolithic variant: ONE board = root + leaf fused
data plane, UP: det / raw + valid + finish + attempt
control plane, DOWN: event bus {START, ABORT, FINISH} + attempt
post-select fast path, UP (stage boards) / gap reject
